name: Payment Due Soon
subject: Reminder: Invoice {invoice_number} Due Soon
body:
Dear {client_name},

This is a friendly reminder that Invoice {invoice_number} for {total} is due on {due_date}.

Please let us know if you have any questions.

Best regards,
{company_name}

name: Payment Overdue
subject: Overdue: Invoice {invoice_number}
body:
Dear {client_name},

Our records indicate that Invoice {invoice_number} for {total} is now overdue.

Please remit payment at your earliest convenience.

Thank you,
{company_name}

name: Second Reminder
subject: Second Notice: Invoice {invoice_number}
body:
Dear {client_name},

This is our second notice regarding Invoice {invoice_number} for {total}.

Immediate payment would be appreciated.

Regards,
{company_name}

name: Final Notice
subject: Final Notice: Invoice {invoice_number}
body:
Dear {client_name},

This is our final notice regarding Invoice {invoice_number} for {total}, which is now {days_overdue} days overdue.

If payment is not received within 5 business days, we may need to take further action.

Please contact us immediately to resolve this matter.

{company_name}
